server_file.label: Connection: Home Assistant server file
server_file.description: File containing the Home Assistant base URL. This keeps the URL outside the declarative plugin config.

token_file.label: Connection: Home Assistant token file
token_file.description: File containing a long-lived Home Assistant token. It is read only at runtime and never stored by the plugin.

allow_insecure_tls.label: Connection: Allow insecure TLS
allow_insecure_tls.description: Skip HTTPS certificate verification. Use only for a trusted Home Assistant with a self-signed certificate.

refresh_interval.label: Connection: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_interval.description: How often to rediscover active Home Assistant usage metrics.

bar_display_mode.label: Bar: Display mode
bar_display_mode.description: Icon is the compact icon-only mode; detailed shows discovered metrics per the toggles below.

bar_metric_window.label: Bar: Quota window
bar_metric_window.description: Choose the 5h/session or weekly quota displayed in the bar. Both stacks a second, smaller progress bar for the other window under the first. Providers with category-only quotas remain visible.

bar_card_filter.label: Bar: Cards
bar_card_filter.description: Optional comma-separated card names or account fragments to show, matched case-insensitively. For example: Pro, Antigravity, Codex. Leave empty to show all discovered cards.

bar_metric_limit.label: Bar: Metric limit
bar_metric_limit.description: Maximum number of discovered usage metrics displayed in this bar instance.

bar_show_name.label: Bar: Show metric name
bar_show_name.description: Show Home Assistant's discovered metric label in the bar.

bar_show_value.label: Bar: Show percentage
bar_show_value.description: Show the usage percentage in the bar. It remains available in the tooltip and panel when disabled.

bar_show_progress.label: Bar: Show progress bar
bar_show_progress.description: Show a compact usage bar beside each metric.

bar_show_reset.label: Bar: Show reset time
bar_show_reset.description: Show a reset time in the bar when the integration exposes one.

bar_show_remaining.label: Bar: Show remaining instead of used
bar_show_remaining.description: Invert percentage labels while retaining usage-colored progress bars. Only visible when "Bar: Show percentage" is also enabled -- there's no percentage label to invert otherwise.

panel_dashboard_path.label: Panel: Home Assistant link path
panel_dashboard_path.description: Relative path opened by the panel's Home Assistant link, appended to the server URL. For example: /mi-casa/data#ai-quotas.

panel_card_filter.label: Panel: Cards
panel_card_filter.description: Optional comma-separated card names or account fragments to show in the panel, matched case-insensitively. For example: Pro, Antigravity, Codex. Cards appear in this order rather than provider order, then by the order any tied cards would otherwise sort in. Leave empty to show every discovered card, unreordered.

panel_compact.label: Panel: Compact mode
panel_compact.description: Shrink the popup panel's cards -- smaller ring, tighter padding, spacing and fonts, no absolute reset time -- so more providers fit without scrolling. Pace and the relative reset countdown stay.

panel_all_metrics.label: Panel: Show all metrics
panel_all_metrics.description: Show every discovered metric per card, including GitHub Copilot's Chat/Completions quotas and Antigravity's 3P model quotas. Disable to show only each card's headline session/weekly windows (or its primary quota for category-only providers like Copilot).

panel_size.label: Panel: Size
panel_size.description: Noctalia panels have a fixed height, so this picks one of a few preset sizes instead of resizing dynamically. Automatic estimates the right size from the currently discovered cards and metrics.

panel_ring_normal_color.label: Panel: Ring color
panel_ring_normal_color.description: Ring color while the window still has plenty of time left.

panel_ring_warning_color.label: Panel: Ring warning color
panel_ring_warning_color.description: Ring color once less than a quarter of the window remains.

panel_ring_critical_color.label: Panel: Ring critical color
panel_ring_critical_color.description: Ring color once less than a tenth of the window remains.

reset_time_format.label: Shared: Reset-time format
reset_time_format.description: How reset timestamps are rendered in the bar, tooltip and panel.

normal_color.label: Shared: Normal color
normal_color.description: Color below the warning threshold. Used by the bar and the panel.

warning_color.label: Shared: Warning color
warning_color.description: Color at or above the warning threshold. Used by the bar and the panel.

critical_color.label: Shared: Critical color
critical_color.description: Color at or above the critical threshold. Used by the bar and the panel.

warning_threshold.label: Shared: Warning threshold (%)
warning_threshold.description: Usage percentage that switches to the warning color.

critical_threshold.label: Shared: Critical threshold (%)
critical_threshold.description: Usage percentage that switches to the critical color.

bar_spacing.label: Bar: Spacing
bar_spacing.description: Gap inside a card in pixels; cards are separated by twice this.
